geopolitics_summary: Escalating US Iran sanctions and hybrid threats to Romanian offshore gas infrastructure; European heatwaves and Danube drought threaten hydropower and cooling.

themes.headline: Romanian offshore gas platform targeted by drone; Moscow blamed
themes.why_it_matters: Direct threat to Romania's offshore gas production (Black Sea platform). Hybrid warfare risk could disrupt EU gas supply; pressure on TTF via reduced intra-EU gas availability and forced reliance on LNG.

themes.headline: Danube drying up; EU lacks contingency plan for inland water transport
themes.why_it_matters: Low Danube water levels restrict barge transport of coal to thermal plants; forces fuel switching to gas and costlier alternatives. Risks regional power tightness, especially Central Europe.

themes.headline: Trump administration tightens Iran economic sanctions; production and export risk
themes.why_it_matters: Stricter Iran sanctions could suppress global crude supply, supporting Brent. Higher oil prices feed into EU gas LNG arbs (crude-linked LNG from Atlantic cheaper); potential TTF uplift if OPEC+ cuts offset demand destruction.

themes.headline: European heatwaves and wildfires; EU calls for climate-resilience capex spending
themes.why_it_matters: Sustained heat reduces hydro output and cooling capacity for thermal/nuclear plants. Forces peaking plant dispatch; tightens DA/ID markets. Wildfires risk transmission line damage and supply disruptions across Southern/Central Europe.

themes.headline: Permian super-lateral wells boost US shale crude and gas output
themes.why_it_matters: Higher US shale production increases LNG export capacity; expands supply to Europe. Lower LNG prices weaken TTF, eroding gas-fired power margins and power prices in EU baseload.

watchlist: Romanian offshore platform security status and production continuity updates
Danube water-level recovery forecasts; coal barge transport reopening timeline
Iranian crude export flows under new sanctions; OPEC+ meeting response
European heatwave/drought relief timeline; hydropower reservoir refill outlook
